_meta.description: Federal budget / appropriations legislative events. Used by insider_vs_calendar.py to overlay against Form 4 insider sales. Extend with new events each FY.

events.summary: FY25 CR signed (Sept 26, 2024) — funded government at FY24 levels through Dec 20, 2024. The CR did not include new program funding for IONQ-style earmarks; effectively the first signal that prior-year earmarks were at risk.

House passed FY25 full-year continuing appropriations bill — confirmed earlier zero-allocation to IONQ's direct AFRL contract; first concrete legislative signal of permanent de-funding. Wolfpack cites this date as the day IONQ's ex-CEO Chapman sold $37.5M (first-ever discretionary sale).
Senate passed FY25 full-year CR; confirmed Pentagon's de-funding of legacy earmarks.
President signed FY25 appropriations; locked in absence of IONQ direct earmark funding.
FY26 bipartisan budget signed. IONQ direct AFRL contract unfunded for the second consecutive year. Qubitekk earmark renewed.

DoD published FY27 RDT&E and Procurement J-Books. Confirmed Tranche 3 Transport Layer unfunded for second year; SDA dissolved; SDN sole-sourced to SpaceX. This is the date Wolfpack cites as making the YSS thesis confirmable from public budget docs.
Air & Space Forces Magazine reported SDN replacement and Pentagon's stance on second-vendor (no timeline, no binding commitment).
End of FY25; FY25 unobligated balances revert.
